title: GL-07 — EC2 and EBS
stopChargesPanel: Terminate the instance and wait, detach and delete the gp3 volume, then delete the snapshot tagged gl-07.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on EC2 and EBS. UL-07 adds the EFS file system. Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Pick the default VPC subnet
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text`.
Run `$SubnetId = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId Name=default-for-az,Values=true --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text`.
Stop if either value is None.
Success: `$VpcId` and `$SubnetId` are set.

steps.title: Launch t3.micro
bullets: Run `$AmiId = aws ssm get-parameters --names /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 --query "Parameters[0].Value" --output text`.

Run `$InstanceId = aws ec2 run-instances --image-id $AmiId --instance-type t3.micro --subnet-id $SubnetId --tag-specifications "ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-07},{Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab}]" --query "Instances[0].InstanceId" --output text`.
Run `aws ec2 wait instance-running --instance-ids $InstanceId`.
Success: `$InstanceId` is running.

steps.title: Attach gp3 volume
bullets: Run `$Az = aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId --query Reservations[0].Instances[0].Placement.AvailabilityZone --output text`.
Run `$VolumeId = aws ec2 create-volume --availability-zone $Az --size 8 --volume-type gp3 --query VolumeId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=volume,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-07}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 wait volume-available --volume-ids $VolumeId`.
Run `aws ec2 attach-volume --volume-id $VolumeId --instance-id $InstanceId --device /dev/sdf`.
Success: volume State is in-use.

steps.title: Snapshot the volume
bullets: Run `$SnapshotId = aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id $VolumeId --description "gl07 lab" --query SnapshotId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=snapshot,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-07}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SnapshotId`.
Success: `$SnapshotId` is completed.

steps.title: Terminate instance
bullets: Run `aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId`.
Run `aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId`.
Success: instance is terminated.

steps.title: Detach and delete volume
bullets: Run `aws ec2 detach-volume --volume-id $VolumeId`.
Run `aws ec2 wait volume-available --volume-ids $VolumeId`.
Run `aws ec2 delete-volume --volume-id $VolumeId`.
Success: describe-volumes returns empty for `$VolumeId`.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: instance (if still running), any remaining volume (detach, wait until available, delete), snapshot. NotFound means the volume is already gone; IncorrectState on detach means it is already detached.
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-07` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: if ($InstanceId) { aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId; aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId }
if ($VolumeId) { aws ec2 detach-volume --volume-id $VolumeId; aws ec2 wait volume-available --volume-ids $VolumeId; aws ec2 delete-volume --volume-id $VolumeId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-07 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-07 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-07. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Launch a t3.micro, attach gp3, snapshot, terminate, and delete volumes. Stopped instances still bill EBS.
